title: Analytic continuation uses the minimax grid with a 1e-12 Tikhonov penalty

regularization.meaning: Tikhonov penalty coefficient applied to the minimax time-frequency grid used by the analytic continuation. The production value is 1e-12.

adjust.symptom: the analytic continuation oscillates or produces unstable quasiparticle roots
adjust.effect: a larger Tikhonov penalty stabilizes the fit
adjust.guard: record the paired run; do not change the coefficient together with nfreq

adjust.symptom: the continuation is visibly over-smoothed and the near-gap states lose structure
adjust.effect: a smaller penalty follows the data more closely
adjust.guard: stop at 1e-12 for production unless a convergence pair shows an improvement

constraints: n_params_anacon = -1 uses all nfreq points for the continuation (the documented LibRPA default); do not set a fixed Pade order in production.
The penalty is applied to the minimax grid construction (TFGrids::generate_minimax -> get_minimax_grid); the input key is regularization.
LibRPA ignores unknown keys, so the run log must echo regularization = 1e-12; the stage gate checks the driver parameter dump.
Changing the coefficient changes the continuation, not the time-frequency data; keep every other key identical in a comparison pair.
